show.description: When prodigy Virat is accused of cheating after his answers mirror his brother Shivaay’s, his world collapses. But fate grants him a second run. Armed with foresight, he re-enters the global contest, hunting the truth behind a chilling secret that’s copying his mind. In a battle of intellect and illusion, trust is the real puzzle.
